article.title: Section 438 of the Code not to apply to persons committing an offence under the Act.
article.content: Nothing in section 438 of the Code shall apply in relation to any case involving the arrest of any person on an accusation of having committed an offence under this Act.
article.html:
18Section 438 of the Code not to apply to persons committing an offence under the Act.

Section 18 · Chapter V · page 16 of the Act

Nothing in section 438 of the Code shall apply in relation to any case involving the arrest of any person on an accusation of having committed an offence under this Act.
